Keep altitude below 600 meters.

text: Strider 1, your altitude is a little high. Keep an eye on your altimeter.

text: Searchlight up ahead. Watch for it.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Stay out of their sight.

speaker: Basilisk Team
text: Strider, Basilisk 1. Our current ETA matches yours.

text: We'll catch them off guard, but can we secure the LZ quickly?

speaker: Strider 2 Count

text: Everyone here's already signed their wills.

text: That ain't funny.

speaker: Basilisk Team
text: Never was good at jokes.

speaker: Basilisk Team
text: Okay, we'll follow you in. Good luck.

text: Understood.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Strider 1, you've passed through waypoint 2.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: The valley's about to get narrower. Be careful.

speaker: Strider 2 Count
text: When can we take on the final mission? I'm starting to get tired of all this.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: This is the last step, Count. We'll take the enemy base and use it as a bridgehead.

speaker: Strider 3 Jaeger
text: Watch yourselves out there. We're going to need all of you in Farbanti.

speaker: Strider 2 Count
text: Without Wiseman here, everybody wants to give orders like they're the company commander himself.

speaker: Strider 2 Count
text: The best thing about Strider Squadron is that our leader keeps his mouth shut.

speaker: Strider 3 Jaeger
text: Watch your speed.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: You've passed waypoint 3.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: You're coming up on the base. Imposing radio silence.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: We won't be able to talk again until you're over the base.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Continue to keep an eye on your altitude. There're plenty of dark spots that can sneak up on you.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: You just passed through waypoint 4.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Radio silence has been lifted! You're almost at the base!

speaker: Strider 2 Count
text: We made it. That was quite the roller coaster ride.

speaker: Strider 4 Lanza
text: Visual confirmation on the air base! Reached destination.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Commence the attack. It's time for their wakeup call!

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: The longer it takes, the worse off we'll be. Hurry up, finish them off.

speaker: Strider 2 Count
text: All right, let's give them a beating!

speaker: Strider 3 Jaeger
text: Locked on! Go down!

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Enemies are attacking!

speaker: Erusean Base
text: Where the hell did they come from?

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Strider 1! Locked on target!

speaker: Erusean Base
text: Fire up the searchlights! I can't see where the enemies are coming from!

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: It looks like the enemy's air defenses are online. I guess they finally decided to wake up.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Keep up the attack. The sooner we finish this thing, the better.

speaker: Basilisk Team
text: This is Basilisk 1. We've arrived in the AO.

speaker: Basilisk Team
text: Landing now!

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: Roger that.

speaker: AWACS Long Caster
text: If the enemy is still present in large numbers when our ground forces arrive, the mission will be a failure.
